hxcommandbutton.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit command button control API. Command buttons are typically used in modal dialogs (for example, the "OK" and "Cancel" widgets).

Function Documentation

HxResult HxCommandButtonDelete ( HxCommandButton_t *  pCmdButton  ) 

Delete a command button widget.

This function deletes a button created from an earlier call to HxCommandButtonNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxCommandButtonDelete only needs to be called when removing a command button at runtime.

Parameters:
pCmdButton IN: Pointer to the button to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxCommandButtonNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const char *  pText,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
HxCommandButton_t **  hCmdButton 
)

Create a command button widget.

This function creates a new command button widget.

The (x,y) of pBounds is used to position the command button within its parent. If either x or y is set to kHxCommandButtonAutoPosition, then the system takes care of positioning the command button within a dialog. When auto-positioning, the system places the first command button created at the bottom left corner of the dialog. The next button created is placed at the appropriate offset from the first button. HX_INVALID_ARG is returned if pParent is not a dialog.

By default, a command button has a width of 70 pixels, or the width of the pText label, whichever is larger. To use this default width, set pBounds->w to 0. Otherwise, the pBounds->w value is used to set the command button's width.

Command buttons always have the height for only label. Consequently, pBounds->h is ignored. If an application needs to have a button that contains several lines of text, a HxGadget_t should be used.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget containing button
pText IN: Pointer to the text for the button label
pBounds IN: Pointer to rectangle (see comments above)
hCmdButton OUT: Handle to the new button; *hCmdButton is NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.

HxResult HxCommandButtonSetFont ( HxCommandButton_t *  pCmdButton,
HxFont_t *  pFont 
)

Set the command button font.

HxCommandButtonSetFont allows an application to set the font for the button's label. If pFont is set to NULL, the system default font is used.

Parameters:
pCmdButton IN: Pointer to a button
pFont IN: Pointer to a font
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxCommandButtonSetText ( HxCommandButton_t *  pCmdButton,
const char *  pText 
)

Set the command button text.

HxCommandButtonSetText allows an application to set the text for the button's label. If pText is set to NULL, the string is cleared. This call will not affect a button's width.

Parameters:
pCmdButton IN: Pointer to a button
pText IN: Pointer to a text
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
